reviews.author: rose
reviews.text:
From the atmosphere to the taste of the snacks, everything is missing at Konkuk University Rose Wine Shop’s maternal family’s house! 🍀 It's a place that was built by renovating a house, so it's cozy and great for conversation. The Jeju Flycatcher Shrimp Sashimi here is truly the best restaurant of all time.. The sweetness that melts in your mouth is no joke⭐️⭐️⭐️ Even the shrimp ramen with the shrimp head is 4,000 won worth of happiness itself! The spicy cream pasta is also amazing as a side dish with drinks. The tripe stew and water parsley pancakes I had before were so delicious that I want to break the seal on the entire menu🤤 If you're looking for a quiet place in Konkuk University with delicious snacks, don't hesitate and come here! I definitely intend to visit again!! 💖

This is my third visit to 'Jangmisulsang Oegatjib,' and it never disappoints! 🍀 Located in a quiet alley near Konkuk Univ. Station, this cozy house-turned-pub has the perfect "Grandma's house" vibe for a chill night out.

The absolute must-order is the Jeju Red Banded Lobster (Ttaksaewoo-hoe). It’s incredibly sweet and fresh—honestly the best I’ve had! 🥹 If you order the lobster, you can add a 'Shrimp Ramen' for just 4,000 KRW, where they use the lobster heads to make a deep, flavorful broth. It’s the perfect way to wrap up your meal. I also loved the Spicy Cream Pasta; it’s rich, hearty, and has just the right amount of kick. ❤️‍🔥

The atmosphere is spacious and comfortable, making it great for groups or dates. If you want high-quality Korean pub food (Anju) away from the noisy main streets, this is definitely the spot. 100% recommended! ⭕️💖

reviews.text:
The location is closer to Children's Grand Park Station than Konkuk University.
It's my first time going here, but I heard it's a famous place that's been around for 20 to 30 years.

The retro feel you get from the sign is amplified as you go down to the basement.
The moment you step inside, you will see a hideout that feels like a different world from the outside.

For some reason, the sticky-looking table, the dark lighting, the walls full of graffiti, and the pleasant smell of cum on the sofa all harmoniously bring back memories from the late 90s and early 2000s.

The price is also out of sync with the times. These days, no matter where you go in the countryside, you wonder if 2,800 won for soju is reasonable. Of course, snacks are also cheap.

Of course, it's not a great restaurant. But it was the best feeling of drinking in a cozy hideout feeling👍👍

It may be noisy when there are a lot of college students.
This seems to come to mind when I crave an accompaniment to a light Western meal!

reviews.text: Tucked away in a back alley, this LP record restaurant is a music lover's paradise. The owner owns thousands of classic LP records, from jazz to rock, and the sound quality is so clear it gives you goosebumps. This is a space where you can truly immerse yourself in music. With no noise from nearby bars or cafes, you'll find yourself lowering your voice without even realizing it. Each table has a headphone jack so you can immerse yourself in your own music world. The food is simple but good, and doesn't interfere with the music. The only downside is that seating is limited and reservations are required on weekends. If you're tired of music being just background noise, this is where you can rediscover the true meaning of music listening.

reviews.text: This is a cozy speakeasy bar created for people who want to make new friends and connect. The colorful cocktail menu and attractive retro interior stand out. Both the manager and bartender are very welcoming to foreign customers, and the atmosphere is lively and welcoming to new customers. If you want to relax and meet fun people in the Gondae area, this is a must-visit place.

reviews.author: YUNJAE KIM
reviews.text:
It wasn't okay at all whether it was unlimited or a la carte.
The taste and quality were below expectations and I felt it was a waste of money and time.

The cocktail I ordered in the unlimited menu was mainly made with syrup flavor and did not have the unique balance of a cocktail.
Some glasses came out lukewarm because they weren't even shaken.

The individual items were not much different.
The margarita had no salt and only had a strong syrup taste.
The gin martini is unbalanced, so locals who don't know Korean food in Southeast Asia
It felt like I was making bibimbap by adding pickled radish to it.
This is not a martini or a margarita.

At 18,000 won for 6 wings, I didn't feel like it was good value for money.

Overall, the unlimited food, single items, and snacks were all disappointing.
I thought you shouldn't eat cocktails in Korea.

reviews.author: PJ
reviews.text: It was so nice of you to open the ceiling around sunset! If you go there in person, the atmosphere is even better, so you might get drunk🥰 The cocktails are delicious, and when I told them what style I wanted, they combined recipes that weren't on the menu and made it really delicious. The pizza downstairs is also famous! I highly recommend going on a special day!

reviews.author: Truong
reviews.text:
I ate on the rooftop because I liked it✨
It was evening and the atmosphere was nice, so we went on a proper date. The pizza was delicious, so we found the right pizza restaurant in Konkuk University! It was a shame that I couldn't eat it because I didn't know there was dipping sauce, but everyone asks for it and make sure to dip the end!!! It tastes good even if you just eat it.

reviews.author: Songhee
reviews.text:
Atmospheric music, emotional lighting, open space,
And even delicious cocktails.
For those who really want to enjoy the restaurant atmosphere of Konkuk University Station
It was the perfect space.
​
To finish, take the bus at the stop right in front and go home comfortably🚍
Isn’t this combination perfect?
I was pleasantly drunk and completely healed on my way home.
Next time, I plan to come first and try the pizza as well🍕
​
